source_data.desc: Neutral is the alignment of those who prefer to avoid moral questions and don't take sides, doing what seems best at the time. Someone who's bored by moral debate is probably Neutral.

translation_provenance.attribution: DND-BofA curated translation (machine translation, editorial review required)

en.description: Neutral is the alignment of those who prefer to avoid moral questions and don't take sides, doing what seems best at the time. Someone who's bored by moral debate is probably Neutral.
en.name: Neutral

ru.description: Нейтральное — это мировоззрение тех, кто предпочитает избегать моральных вопросов и не принимает чью-либо сторону, делая то, что кажется лучшим в данный момент. Кто-то, кому скучны моральные дебаты, вероятно, нейтральный.
ru.name: Нейтральное
